domain.title: Coaching Knowledge Vault
scope_in: behavior change, habit formation (as used in coaching)
scope_out: pure marketing copy or author biography

core: This vault stores paraphrased, teachable coaching knowledge for education and content generation. Notes must be actionable and grounded: define concepts, show how to apply them, include boundary conditions, common pitfalls, and at least one practical example. Prefer concise, neutral wording. Mark presumed prerequisites as link-intents using [[...]]; unresolved terms become stubs later.

paraphrase_rules: Do not quote source text; rewrite in your own words.
Avoid book-like filler; prefer operational statements.
When unsure, mark as unknown rather than inventing details.
Use short sections with clear headings.
banned_patterns: unsupported claims not present in provided context

steps.gate: Skip content that is promotional, author biography, acknowledgements, or unrelated front matter. Prioritize definitions, models, examples, and operational guidance.
steps.modeler: Model notes as: Definition → When to use → How to apply (steps/questions) → Boundary conditions → Pitfalls → Variants/related concepts. Add [[Link Intents]] for prerequisites and assumed terms.
steps.storyteller: Stories are business fables that teach the intended coaching concept(s) implicitly through character action, then make the lesson explicit in a short debrief. Keep it plausible and non-cheesy. Append CONTENT_MANIFEST.
